# Meridian Vu

> Meridian Vu builds AI systems that take repeat work off small teams, and runs SEO, product photo and store upkeep retainers for Shopify brands. She works remote and async from Las Vegas, NV (Pacific time), with set prices. Background: 10+ years in design, ecommerce and short-form content, FIDM Product Development, print production at Ruggable, founder of the fashion label Yumelixir.

Contact: MeridianVu@gmail.com | https://www.linkedin.com/in/meridianvu | replies within 24 hours on weekdays.

## Services and prices
- [AI Workflow Audit](https://meridianvu.com/services#ai-workflow-audit): $2,500 one time, 1 to 2 weeks. Maps a team's top 10 repeat tasks and picks the 3 AI can take over first.
- [Systems Build](https://meridianvu.com/services#systems-build): $7,500 to $15,000 per project, 3 to 6 weeks. 2 to 5 working AI workflows connected to the tools a team already uses, with how-to guides and walkthroughs.
- [Systems Partner](https://meridianvu.com/services#systems-partner): $5,000 a month. New skills and automations every month, upkeep and a monthly report.
- [Fractional AI Ops Lead](https://meridianvu.com/services#fractional-ai-ops): $8,000 to $12,000 a month, for larger teams.
- [Shopify Store Growth](https://meridianvu.com/services#shopify-growth): retainers from $1,500 a month (Starter $1,500, Growth $2,500, Growth + Social $3,500). SEO, AI lifestyle product photos, collection banners and store upkeep.
- [Store Refresh Sprint](https://meridianvu.com/services#store-refresh): $3,000 one time, about 3 weeks.
- [Launch Projects](https://meridianvu.com/services#launch-projects): Team Playbook $1,500 to $2,500, Brand Launch Kit $2,500 to $4,500, Brand + Store Launch $6,000 to $10,000.

## Case studies
- [KBF Home Improvement](https://meridianvu.com/kbf-case-study): AI systems for a 15,000+ product Shopify store. About 190 work hours a week saved and up to $43K a year in overseas labor costs cut. 10,871 products added in 8 weeks. In the same year (Jan 1 to Nov 10, 2026 vs 2025): net sales +129%, orders +30%, average order +76%, US visits +67%, and 1 in 8 orders came from ChatGPT.
- [Media Scaling](https://meridianvu.com/media-scaling-case-study): 50+ Claude skills and scheduled tasks for a short-form video agency, 35 shared across the strategy team. An estimated 21 hours saved a week per strategy lead.
- [Boston Gift Baskets](https://meridianvu.com/bgb-case-study): Shopify SEO, lifestyle product photos, seasonal banners and store upkeep. +70% sales and +54% orders from Sep 1 to Nov 7, 2026 vs the same dates in 2025. Also a brand kit and a 16 pin Pinterest launch feed.
- [Iris Lee WordPress to Shopify migration](https://meridianvu.com/iris-lee-migration-case-study): I took over a partly finished move from a WordPress menu site to Shopify for a Chestnut Hill, MA bakery. 365 live listings, every one priced, placeholder names like Cake 01 renamed with 385 redirects, SEO titles and descriptions on 358 of 365 products, and the old irisleesweets.com domain forwarding to irislee.com.
- [Boutique Bestie Solutions](https://meridianvu.com/bbs-pinterest-case-study): Pinterest organic and ads for women's clothing boutiques (1099 contract, Mar to May 2026). A Pinterest shopping campaign achieved 5.6x ROAS (return on ad spend) on a 5 week campaign.
